notes: CreatePlaylistsContainer: tail-calls NativePlaylistsManager::Init and returns its array pointer. Init now returns the array (src/native_playlist.cpp). The int return is 1 when the array was allocated and 0 when not, since the original returns the pointer through an int

SetImplicitSegmentCues: per segment, the implicit value is the info record's word 2 (frame_count) minus 1. A cue list of size 1 gets a 0 first, sizes 0 to 2 get the value twice, larger lists once (LABEL_7 then LABEL_3; the ARM size compares agree). Test decoder_native_parse_w10_test

ParseFile: full chunk walk (Afmt, Segm, Cues, Grpe, Rule, Plst, Stat, Trsn, Grps; unknown ids skipped). Fills header_words_ (base offset, format word, field_0c, sample word with 16 at +0x2e). Partial because header body words at +0x0c..+0x17, the Afmt id and size words at +0x1c and +0x20, and fmt bytes past +0x2f are not kept. Trsn passes the last Stat count to CreateTransitionsContainer (the original reads a stack slot only Stat writes). Malformed input returns false where the original would write out of range
